label: D2: a2 led rarely to S1 after an unrewarded a2->S2 trial, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass). Almost all mass (99.5%) is on steps where the agent chose a2 and the rare transition took it to S1 (in_action=2, in_state=1). Within that, it needs the previous trial to be unrewarded (prev_reward=0: 100% of mass), and it is restricted to late episodes: there are no activations before ep_trial 60, and most are at ep_trial 70-99. Precision rises further when the previous trial was also a2 reaching S2 by the common transition (a stay after an unrewarded common trial). Missed mass is about 2% and consists of small activations: rare S1 after a previous rare or a1 trial, plus a few a1->S1 common cases. The false positives (dev precision 0.62) are the same pattern with zero activation, mostly in the ep_trial 65-70 band or right at the start of the window, so the late-episode onset is gradual and not a clean threshold. Model value is low (<7.1) on all activations. Every variable in the predicate is observed at D2. Dev: P 0.62, R 0.88, F1 0.73, mass recall 0.98. It does not fire at D1 or GO, after rewarded trials, or when S2 is reached.
